text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora, who achieved brilliant 
victories in enough GⅠ races to rewrite 
history in the Twinkle Series...!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora-san, having achieved an 
unprecedented feat in Japanese Umamusume 
history! We've talked about so much today, 
but to wrap up—

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text:
To get straight to the point, what is the 
thing you want to do most right now?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah! The beach! I wanna go to the 
beach!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: The seaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's freezing! It's so huge, 
amazing! Wait, what should we do!? What 
should we do!? First off, I wanna splash 
in the waves—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh, ain't that Ai-chan over there?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aii-chan~♡ What a total coincidence, 
what're you up to!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Oh my...! To think you all would be here.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I... well. I just came to take a 
breather."

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Watching you train so stoically is 
wonderful. But rest is important, too.

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
While you still have relatively plenty of 
time, make sure you learn how to rest 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I was told as much, so I came to the beach 
for now, but I'm not really sure what I 
should be doing...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right, Pandora-san. Would you 
mind telling me?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh, me!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I often see you heading out. I wondered if 
you might be quite knowledgeable about the 
outdoors. Would you mind teaching me a 
thing or two?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ngh, jeez~~~! You leave me no choice♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, out of the blue, I ended up 
hanging out with Almond Eye!

text_block_list.name: Pandora & Eye
text_block_list.text: Taaahhh!! Haaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! Got it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "*pant, pant*! Grr... One more time!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Alright~, Castle Ai-chan is complete♡ All 
that's left... is the finishing touches 
with decorations!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Decorations... I see. Sounds wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Look! A starfish! There's a starfish! Sooo 
cuuute~~!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Look, Pandora-san. There was this 
really pretty sea glass.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
! Nice, nice! ♡ Let's search for waaay 
more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, they completely lost themselves 
having fun at the beach...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splash...)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, I'm exhausted~! But that was so 
much fun~!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Me too. It was a day that somehow left me 
feeling full of energy. It seems I was 
able to rest up properly. ...Thank you, 
Pandora.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I seeee, that's great♡ I'll also—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Wait. Huh?! No way!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
The surface of the sea... Doesn't it kinda 
look like Ai-chan's eyes!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Huh? D-Do you really think so?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"It's so crystal clear and sparkling, like 
it's just overflowing with hope—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like, it totally feels like Ai-chan's 
future already!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: My... future?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Sparkly and shiny. A future full of 
excitement!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I see. Is that how it looks to 
you, Pandora-san?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I'll have to do my best too. 
...Me as well.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm rooting for you more than anyone 
in the whole world, Ai-chan♡ ...Ah, but 
don't overdo it, okay~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the feet of the two laughing together, 
gentle waves rolled in and out—as if 
watching over them.
